graph_table_in: SELECT g.author, count(*) AS n, sum(mid % 1000003) AS fingerprint FROM GRAPH_TABLE (social MATCH (m:Message)-[r:Message_hasCreator_Person]->(p:Person) WHERE p.PersonId IN (4398046519825, 2435, 6575, 28587302326226, -1) COLUMNS (p.PersonId AS author, m.MessageId AS mid)) AS g GROUP BY g.author ORDER BY g.author
literal_watchlist:
SELECT g.author, count(*) AS n, sum(g.mid % 1000003) AS fingerprint
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (social MATCH (m:Message)-[r:Message_hasCreator_Person]->(p:Person) COLUMNS (p.PersonId AS author, m.MessageId AS mid)) AS g
JOIN (VALUES (4398046519825::BIGINT), (2435::BIGINT), (6575::BIGINT), (28587302326226::BIGINT), (-1::BIGINT)) AS watch(author) ON watch.author = g.author
GROUP BY g.author ORDER BY g.author
view_exists: SELECT w.author FROM watch w WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected s WHERE s.author=w.author) ORDER BY w.author
gql_fanout: MATCH (m:Message)-[r:Message_hasCreator_Person]->(p:Person) WHERE p.PersonId = 4398046519825 RETURN m.MessageId AS id
explain_only:
EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) SELECT g.author, count(*) AS n, sum(g.mid % 1000003) AS fingerprint
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (social MATCH (m:Message)-[r:Message_hasCreator_Person]->(p:Person) COLUMNS (p.PersonId AS author, m.MessageId AS mid)) AS g
JOIN (VALUES (4398046519825::BIGINT), (2435::BIGINT), (6575::BIGINT), (28587302326226::BIGINT), (-1::BIGINT)) AS watch(author) ON watch.author = g.author
GROUP BY g.author ORDER BY g.author
